narrative_passages.title: The dry path in the sea

summary_for_children: Surah Ta-Ha tells how Musa saw a fire in the night and was called by Allah, how as a baby he was placed in a chest on the river, how he and Harun went to Pharaoh with gentle words, and how Allah saved the believers through the sea.
world_title: Fire in the Valley of Tuwa
environment_concept: A night journey toward a distant fire that becomes the start of Musa's mission: a sacred valley, a river with a floating chest, the palace road, a dry path through the sea and a lonely desert where a calf is melted away.
architecture_and_scenery: Dark desert valley with a single far-off fire, a reedy riverbank, a sandstone palace forecourt, a parted sea floor of wet sand, and a camp beneath bare hills.

palette.lighting: One warm firelight against a blue night, then hard desert sun
palette.atmosphere: Cold night wind, river reeds, sea spray

areas.name: The Distant Fire
areas.description: A single fire glowing far across the dark valley; the walk toward it begins the world.

areas.name: Valley of Tuwa
areas.description: A hushed valley floor: the player leaves their own sandals at the edge (adaptation).

areas.name: The River and the Chest
areas.description: A wooden chest drifting along reeds to the bank; no person is shown.

areas.name: Dry Path Through the Sea
areas.description: Walls of water either side of a dry seabed path.

areas.name: Camp of the Calf
areas.description: An empty camp where a golden calf statue stands, later shown melted and scattered.

activities.name: Follow the firelight
activities.description: Walk through the dark valley guided only by the fire, reading 20:10 at its edge.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: Gentle words
activities.description: Choose the gentle way to speak in short scenarios, then read 20:44.
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

activities.name: The staff and the rope
activities.description: A sorting game separating illusion from truth; nothing is shown of Musa (adaptation).
activities.label: artistic educational adaptation, not an event in the Quran

narration_plan: Narration walks in the Quran's order from the fire to the calf. Musa, Harun and Pharaoh are never shown or voiced; their words are read only as ayahs.
learning_objectives: Explain why the calf was wrong to worship

status.playable_environment: not built: a shared symbolic setting stands in

depiction_rules: No prophet, person or representation of Allah is shown. Unseen realities are never pictured. Interactive activities are labelled as adaptations.
